# Amedisys Home Health Care Services

Home Health Care

Skilled nursing and therapy to help you recover from illness, injury or surgery, or to manage
long-term conditions.

[Start Support ][107]

Hospice Care

Physical, emotional and spiritual care at the end of life, along with help for loved ones.

[Find Comfort ][108]

Palliative Care

Relief from pain and symptoms to help improve quality of life at any stage of a serious illness.

[Find Relief ][109]

Hospital-Level and Skilled Nursing Care at Home

Contessa, an Amedisys company, enables a new standard of care with provider partners and payors.

# Bioness Integrated Therapy System, now with Immersive Functional Reality

Discover a new world of rehabilitation with BITS Functional Reality (BITS FR), designed to support
patients in their recovery.

[Learn about BITS FR][56]

# New Pathways. New Possibilities.

Portable Neuromodulation Stimulator (PoNS), is an innovative, non-surgical treatment option that
helps people with MS or chronic stroke symptoms improve their walking.

[Learn about PoNS][57]

# Improved Mobility. Made Easier.

The L300 Go system uses functional electrical stimulation (FES) to help correct foot drop and thigh
weakness. The system stimulates the nerves and muscles that lift the foot to walk more naturally.

[Learn about L300 Go][58]

# Muscle Movement, Maximized

The L360 Thigh System uses neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and functional electrical
stimulation (FES) to address muscle weakness by helping to strengthen leg muscles, improve knee
stability, and prevent or slow muscle loss due to disuse.

[Learn about L360][59]

# Freedom and function are within reach

The H200 Wireless Hand Rehabilitation System uses functional electrical stimulation (FES) to improve
hand function so users can get back to activities of daily living.

[Learn about H200 Wireless][60]

# Developed by therapists, for therapists

The Vector Gait and Safety System is a ceiling-mounted robotic system that supports a patient’s body
weight during rehabilitation activities. Vector gives patients confidence while allowing clinicians
to focus on performance and outcomes.

[Learn about Vector][61]

# Rehab’s #1 Multidisciplinary Therapy Solution Just Got EVEN Better.

The Bioness Integrated Therapy System (BITS) is a software-based therapy platform that uses an
interactive touchscreen display to challenge, assess, and track a patient’s deficiencies in vision,
cognition, and balance.

[Learn about BITS][62]

# Motion That Matters

The first and only bilateral upper-extremity exoskeleton designed to reflect natural human movement
and enable high-intensity functional therapy.

In development. Not for sale.

[Learn about AURA][63]

# Dynamic Body Weight Support for Real-World Movement

Haloplex is intended for real-world, omni-directional movement during therapy. Built on a proven
foundation and delivered as part of a comprehensive rehab program.

In development. Not for sale.

[Learn about Haloplex][64]

Bioness Medical, Inc. develops medical technologies to support recovery for people living with the

# Bioness Integrated Therapy System, now with Immersive Functional Reality

Discover a new world of rehabilitation with BITS Functional Reality (BITS FR), designed to support
patients in their recovery.

[Learn about BITS FR][56]

# New Pathways. New Possibilities.

Portable Neuromodulation Stimulator (PoNS), is an innovative, non-surgical treatment option that
helps people with MS or chronic stroke symptoms improve their walking.

[Learn about PoNS][57]

# Improved Mobility. Made Easier.

The L300 Go system uses functional electrical stimulation (FES) to help correct foot drop and thigh
weakness. The system stimulates the nerves and muscles that lift the foot to walk more naturally.

[Learn about L300 Go][58]

# Muscle Movement, Maximized

The L360 Thigh System uses neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and functional electrical
stimulation (FES) to address muscle weakness by helping to strengthen leg muscles, improve knee
stability, and prevent or slow muscle loss due to disuse.

[Learn about L360][59]

# Freedom and function are within reach

The H200 Wireless Hand Rehabilitation System uses functional electrical stimulation (FES) to improve
hand function so users can get back to activities of daily living.

[Learn about H200 Wireless][60]

# Developed by therapists, for therapists

The Vector Gait and Safety System is a ceiling-mounted robotic system that supports a patient’s body
weight during rehabilitation activities. Vector gives patients confidence while allowing clinicians
to focus on performance and outcomes.

[Learn about Vector][61]

# Rehab’s #1 Multidisciplinary Therapy Solution Just Got EVEN Better.

The Bioness Integrated Therapy System (BITS) is a software-based therapy platform that uses an
interactive touchscreen display to challenge, assess, and track a patient’s deficiencies in vision,
cognition, and balance.

[Learn about BITS][62]

# Motion That Matters

The first and only bilateral upper-extremity exoskeleton designed to reflect natural human movement
and enable high-intensity functional therapy.

In development. Not for sale.

[Learn about AURA][63]

# Dynamic Body Weight Support for Real-World Movement

Haloplex is intended for real-world, omni-directional movement during therapy. Built on a proven
foundation and delivered as part of a comprehensive rehab program.

In development. Not for sale.

[Learn about Haloplex][64]

## Bioness Medical Announces 510(k) Clearance for PoNS^{®} to Manage Patients Recovering from Stroke

[Read the press release here.][65]

### Bioness Medical Welcomes Antonella Favit-Van Pelt, M.D., Ph.D. as Chief Medical Officer

[Read the press release here.][66]

### Bioness Medical Acquires the Portable Neuromodulation Stimulator (PoNS^{®}) System

April 2026: Bioness Medical makes strategic addition strengthening neurorehabilitation leadership
and expands patient access to non-invasive mobility-enhacing technology

[Read the press release here.][67]

# We Help People Regain Function and Freedom

Bioness Medical, Inc. develops medical technologies to support recovery for people living with the
effects of stroke, brain injury, and other conditions, as well as the clinicians who provide care
for them.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

Advin Corporate House

environment. The workspace reflects Advin’s vision of leadership and excellence in the healthcare
industry.

workflows to handle high-volume medical products with speed, accuracy, and efficiency. Automated

#### [Vision Language Models for Axillary Lymph Nodes][83]

This study evaluated the performance of vision-language models with image-only diagnostic input for
detecting malignancy in biopsied axillary lymph nodes in patients with breast cancer.
Peng He ... Fang-Meng Fu
[article cover]

#### [Super-Resolution DLR for Coronary Stents on CTA][84]

The novel super-resolution deep-learning reconstruction algorithm improves the performance of
coronary CTA obtained on conventional 320-row MDCT scanners and could support expanded use of CTA
for stent evaluation.
Cheng Xu ... Yining Wang
[article cover]

#### [Diabetes Medications and FDG PET Preparation][85]

This *AJR* Expert Panel Narrative Review examines the effects of hyperglycemia and insulin exposure
on [¹⁸F]FDG biodistribution and proposes preparation strategies for patients undergoing oncologic
[¹⁸F]FDG PET.
Philipose G. Mulugeta ... Margo Hudson
[article cover]

#### [Patient Cost-Sharing in Medicare Advantage Plans][86]

Patient cost-sharing for outpatient advanced diagnostic imaging varied across Medicare Advantage
plans, with the emergence of a small percentage of plans having outlier high coinsurance rates or
copayment amounts.
Jessica I. Billig ... Joshua M. Liao
[article cover]

#### [PSMA PET Radiopharmaceuticals][87]

This Special Series Review takes an evidence-based approach to provide insights into clinically
relevant similarities and differences of FDA-approved and late-stage research PSMA PET
radiopharmaceuticals.
Justin G. Peacock ... Phillip H. Kuo
[article cover]

The novel super-resolution deep-learning reconstruction algorithm improves the performance of
coronary CTA obtained on conventional 320-row MDCT scanners and could support expanded use of CTA
for stent evaluation.
Cheng Xu ... Yining Wang
[article cover]

#### [Diabetes Medications and FDG PET Preparation][85]

This *AJR* Expert Panel Narrative Review examines the effects of hyperglycemia and insulin exposure
on [¹⁸F]FDG biodistribution and proposes preparation strategies for patients undergoing oncologic
[¹⁸F]FDG PET.
Philipose G. Mulugeta ... Margo Hudson
[article cover]

#### [Patient Cost-Sharing in Medicare Advantage Plans][86]

Patient cost-sharing for outpatient advanced diagnostic imaging varied across Medicare Advantage
plans, with the emergence of a small percentage of plans having outlier high coinsurance rates or
copayment amounts.
Jessica I. Billig ... Joshua M. Liao
[article cover]

#### [PSMA PET Radiopharmaceuticals][87]

This Special Series Review takes an evidence-based approach to provide insights into clinically
relevant similarities and differences of FDA-approved and late-stage research PSMA PET
radiopharmaceuticals.
Justin G. Peacock ... Phillip H. Kuo
[article cover]

top-tier suppliers to bring the latest and most reliable medical instruments to healthcare
professionals worldwide ][85]
[ [Digital X-ray Radiography System] ][86]
[Digital X-ray Radiography System][87]
[A modern imaging technique that captures radiographic images using digital sensors. It offers
high-quality, immediate imaging with lower radiation exposure, improved storage solutions, and
seamless integration with medical records.][88]
[View More ][89]
[ [Accelerator] ][90]
[Medical Linear Accelerator LINAC][91]
[A sophisticated piece of equipment used primarily in radiation therapy for cancer treatment. LINACs
generate high-energy X-rays or electrons that precisely target tumors while minimizing exposure to
surrounding healthy tissue.][92]
[View More ][93]
[ [7.0T Magnetic Resonance Imaging System] ][94]
[7.0T Magnetic Resonance Imaging System][95]
[A non-invasive imaging technology that uses strong magnetic fields, radio waves, and computer
technology to produce detailed images of organs and tissues within the body.][96]
[View More ][97]
[ [Digestive Endoscopy Series] ][98]
[Digestive Endoscopy Series][99]
[A medical procedure that utilizes an endoscope—a flexible tube equipped with a light and camera—to
visualize the interior of the digestive tract.][100]
[View More ][101]
[ [Special Evacuated Blood Collection Tubes] ][102]
[Special Evacuated Blood Collection Tubes][103]
[Specifically designed containers used to collect and preserve blood samples for laboratory testing.
These tubes are pre-vacuumed to create negative pressure, allowing for easy blood collection with
minimal exposure to air.][104]
[View More ][105]
[ ABOUT OUR COMPANY ][106]
[ Asia-Pacific City Medical Group Limited ][107]
[ APC Medical Group. We have the ability to obtain allocations and are capable of delivering on a
CIF basis. In case you prefer FOB due to having your own logistics arrangements in place, that can
be arranged as well. If you're interested, you can request our Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) or
the SOP regarding a production run. There's no problem in demonstrating our connection to the
specific factory or presenting a bill of lading. It is also pleasure with your request to regularly
report the status of orders. ][108]
[ What sets us apart ][109]
[ Is our unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction and service excellence. ][110]
[ Customer Satisfaction & Trustworthiness ][111]
[ Payment is via sight irrevocable documentary letter of credit, with funds released after the SGS
report and bill of lading. No deposit is needed before or during production. ][112]
[ View More ][113]
[ [Asia-Pacific City Medical Group Limited] ][114]

[ We always want to make sure that our customers are getting the best deal, so let us know what
you're interested in and we'll get back with a quote! ][116]

# Rebuilding Shattered Lives

Victims of negligence need to be able to rely on the law for help

Injured people need support to help them put their lives back together

Anyone could become a victim of negligence – it could happen to you

[Find out more][87]

# What is APIL?

Over the years APIL has grown to become the leading, most respected organisation in this field,
constantly working to promote and develop expertise in the practise of personal injury law, for the
benefit of injured people.

The Association of Personal Injury Lawyers:
* Believes passionately that victims deserve committed, well trained lawyers to support their fight
  for justice;
* Understands that injured people can often be the most vulnerable in society and need help;
* Campaigns to make a tangible difference to the lives of injured people and society as a whole;
* Reassures victims and acts fairly with honesty and integrity;
* Drives up standards in personal injury law and process, encouraging innovation and efficiency;
* Is ‘not for profit’ and does not seek to make money out of the misfortune of injured people;
* Treats law as a rewarding vocation, not a job, and encourages its members to thrive in their work.

APIL’s head office in Nottingham is the base for 25 dedicated full and part time staff who are
responsible for running the day-to-day activities of the organisation, including campaigns, press
and media work, and the development of training and conference programmes.

# Rebuilding Shattered Lives

Victims of negligence need to be able to rely on the law for help

Injured people need support to help them put their lives back together

Anyone could become a victim of negligence – it could happen to you

[Find out more][87]

# What is APIL?

Over the years APIL has grown to become the leading, most respected organisation in this field,
constantly working to promote and develop expertise in the practise of personal injury law, for the
benefit of injured people.

The Association of Personal Injury Lawyers:
* Believes passionately that victims deserve committed, well trained lawyers to support their fight
  for justice;
* Understands that injured people can often be the most vulnerable in society and need help;
* Campaigns to make a tangible difference to the lives of injured people and society as a whole;
* Reassures victims and acts fairly with honesty and integrity;
* Drives up standards in personal injury law and process, encouraging innovation and efficiency;
* Is ‘not for profit’ and does not seek to make money out of the misfortune of injured people;
* Treats law as a rewarding vocation, not a job, and encourages its members to thrive in their work.

APIL’s head office in Nottingham is the base for 25 dedicated full and part time staff who are
responsible for running the day-to-day activities of the organisation, including campaigns, press
and media work, and the development of training and conference programmes.

## *About Us*

## *About Us*

Founded in 1999, BIOBASE is a professional manufacturer whose business covers laboratory equipment,
medical device, engineering project and cosmetics. With more than 3,000 employees, 25+ factories,
BIOBASE has established overseas branches in USA, UAE, Singapore, Kazakhstan, India and other
countries. BIOBASE has long-term business partners in 190+ countries. BIOBASE can provide one-stop
solutions for laboratory and medical fields. Main products include biological safety cabinet,
laminar flow cabinet, fume hood, refrigerator & freezer, autoclave, oven, incubator, centrifuge,
wheel chair, hospital bed, IVD instrument, clean room project, etc. BIOBASE has certificates
including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, ISO45001, FDA, NSF49, EN12469, MET, CE, ETL, etc. BIOBASE
would like to establish win-win business cooperation with distributors all over the world.

From strains to finished products, Biose Industrie manufactures microbiome solutions for
pharmaceutical and non-pharmaceutical markets, supporting projects from development to commercial

##### Biose

## BIOSE INDUSTRIE

Biose Industrie is a specialised microbiome CDMO supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and
consumer-focused companies across Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), Next-Generation Probiotics
(NGPs), consumer health, consumer care, and cosmetics.

We combine deep aerobic and anaerobic microbiology expertise, industrial scale, and robust GMP
quality systems to take projects from development to commercialisation.

##### Vision

## Vision

Our vision is to build a future where the potential of micro-organisms strengthens and enhances
health and well-being, across regulated pharmaceutical applications and everyday consumer solutions.

##### Identity

## Identity

A pioneer in pharmaceutical microbiology since 1951, Biose Industrie operates two complementary
businesses serving a wide range of industries:

### CDMO Services

An international CDMO specialised in Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and Next-Generation
Probiotics (NGPs), from process development to GMP drug product manufacturing.

### Strains, Ingredients & Finished Products

Supplier of microbiome-based ingredients and finished products under private label for the health,
nutrition, wellness, and cosmetic markets.

##### Mission

## Mission

Our mission is to contribute to the success and satisfaction of our clients by delivering
micro-organism-based solutions — ingredients, finished products, and dedicated developments — driven
by scientific excellence, industrial performance, and anticipation of regulatory and market
evolutions.

At Biotech, we believe that every customer is important, and we take pride in our ability to serve
the needs of a diverse range of clients. With over three decades of experience in the field of
physiotherapy, we have developed a deep understanding of the unique requirements of individual
clinicians and large corporate customers alike.

Our range of products and services is tailored to meet the specific needs of each of our clients,
with innovative solutions for Ortho Rehab, Neuro Rehab, Cardio Rehab, and Sports Rehab. Whether you
are looking to set up a new rehabilitation department or upgrade your existing equipment, our team
of experts is always ready to help.

## Our purpose is you.

At CHRISTUS Health, helping you enjoy your best health is more than just a goal. It’s our purpose.
It’s something each of us commits ourselves to every day. Every program, service and treatment we
provide is focused on elevating the health of all those who come to us – body, mind and spirit.

[ View All Services ][109]

  [Couple of seniors jogging outdoors in the city]
  Heart Care

  ][113]

## Care Where and When You Need It
* [
  
  #### Primary Care
  
  Find a provider who will become your partner in better health, offering preventive care, guidance
  and treatment.
  ][114]
* [
  
  #### Urgent Care
  
  Get immediate attention for medical conditions that don’t require a hospital emergency room. Save
  time, check-in online.
  ][115]
* [
  
  #### Virtual Care On Demand
  
  Schedule a video or telephone visit with a caring provider from just about anywhere you are. 
  ][116]

## Become One of the Faces of CHRISTUS

Join a team that extends the healing ministry of Jesus Christ and creates innovative health and
wellness solutions for individuals and communities. Join a company that values dignity, integrity
and compassion, and where you can grow and deliver quality health care.

[Hispanic woman in a suit with mid-length brunette hair smiling at the camera. ]
Associates

At CHRISTUS Health we value you, for you. We know the work you do will make a difference. Join our
family of caregivers, build your career at CHRISTUS and you’ll develop meaningful relationships
while you positively impact lives in our communities.

[ Become a CHRISTUS Associate ][117]
[Happy CHRISTUS nurse smiling into the camera with maroon scrubs on]
Nursing

Nurses are the heart of the CHRISTUS Health family. Whether you are a seasoned nurse, or a new grad,
you will find a wealth of opportunity at CHRISTUS. We care for our nurses – providing excellent
benefits, educational opportunities, shift differentials, clinical ladder programs and more -- so
our nurses can focus on care for our patients. The perfect nursing position is waiting for you.

[ Become a CHRISTUS Nurse ][118]
[Smiling Doctor with stethoscoope]
Physicians

We serve our communities by providing a complete healing experience. Above all, we are committed to
caring for the whole person – mind, body and spirit, because we understand that caring for our
patients goes beyond their physical needs. Become a CHRISTUS physician and find more than a job,
find a calling to serve patients, their families and all our communities with dignity and
compassion.

[ Become A CHRISTUS Physician ][119]

## Our CHRISTUS

[ ][120]
[ ][121]

## CHRISTUS Health at a Glance
* The CHRISTUS Family More than 45,000 dedicated team members—including 15,000 clinicians—provide
  personalized care to our neighbors across the globe. [Community Involvement][122]
* Our Communities Across each of the communities we serve, CHRISTUS Health continues to expand our
  locations to provide more options for exceptional care. [Search Locations][123]
* Our Care We are constantly working to enhance and expand our services by adopting the best
  practices in every aspect of preventative care and treatment. [Learn About the Services &
  Conditions We Treat][124]

[A preschool age girl holds her stuffed animal toy as she talks with a female pediatrician during a
well visit.]

## CHRISTUS Health Plan

Find the right plan for your life and enroll today with CHRISTUS Health Plan.

[ Individual & Family Plans ][125]
[ Medicare Advantage Plans ][126]
[ US Family Health Plan ][127]

## Your Health Hub

[ [A newborn baby takes a bottle from mom]

Your Newborn Feeding Guide

Wondering how often your newborn should eat, what hunger cues look like, or whether those
post-feeding hiccups are normal? This newborn feeding guide answers common questions about
breastfeeding, bottle-feeding, formula feeding and newborn feeding schedules so you can feel more
confident during feeding time.

][128]

Simple answers to questions about your health and care.

[

What Support Really Feels Like as an IMC Nurse

Discover how IMC nurses at CHRISTUS Health in San Marcos find support, teamwork and career growth
while caring for patients with complex medical needs.

][129] [

Essential Wellness Tips for New Moms

Discover essential strategies to support your physical, emotional, and mental health as a new
mother.

][130] [

How to Create Your Birth Plan

While there are no guarantees, a birth plan is a helpful tool to help you communicate your
preferences and expectations for labor and delivery with your health care team. Here's how to create
yours personalized birth plan.

][131] [

CHRISTUS Health in Alamogordo Earns ‘A’ for Patient Safety

Learn how CHRISTUS Hospital earned an ‘A’ safety grade through continuous improvements, better
communication, and advanced ICU telehealth care.

][132]

## CHRISTUS News & Latest Updates [ View More ][133]

[ [Good Shepherd Platinum Award Group Photo] ][134] [CHRISTUS Health in Longview named among
nation’s top performers for heart attack care][135]
CHRISTUS Heart and Vascular Institute in Longview has been recognized with the Platinum Performance
Achievement Award from the American College of Cardiology's NCDR Chest Pain – MI Registry.
[ [Northwestern State University (NSU) Cenla campus nurses in training] ][136] [CHRISTUS Health
grows cohort programs for Central Louisiana healthcare students][137]
In an effort to strengthen the local healthcare workforce and create new opportunities for aspiring
clinicians, CHRISTUS Health is expanding its tuition-free cohort program.
[ [CH SETX Jasper Memorial Stroke Award] ][138] [CHRISTUS Health receives national award for
comprehensive stroke care][139]
CHRISTUS Health has earned national recognition from the American Heart Association and American
Stroke Association for its commitment to providing high-quality stroke care in Southeast Texas.
[ [Kurt DeVaney] ][140] [CHRISTUS Health Names Kurt DeVaney President of CHRISTUS Health Mount
Pleasant][141]
CHRISTUS Health has named Kurt DeVaney president of CHRISTUS Health Mount Pleasant. DeVaney brings
extensive healthcare leadership experience and a focus on expanding access to high-quality care
across Titus County and East Texas.
[ [DiVinci 5] ][142] [From awareness to action: CHRISTUS Health encourages knowing hernia
symptoms][143]
CHRISTUS Health is raising awareness about the prevalence of hernias, their symptoms and the
advanced treatment options now available to patients in Southeast Texas.
[ [Mother Frances Xonar Security System] ][144] [CHRISTUS Health launches new safety initiatives for
patients and visitors][145]
CHRISTUS Health announced today the installation of a new weapons detection system designed to
enhance Associate, patient and visitor safety protocols.
[ [CHRISTUS Ochsner Lake Area Hospital Maternal Health Room] ][146] [Innovative maternal health
services to expand access to personalized, reliable care][147]
CHRISTUS Health welcomed community members and media to CHRISTUS Ochsner Lake Area Hospital for an
exclusive preview of a new model maternal health room designed to transform care for mothers and
babies across Southwest Louisiana.

## Our purpose is you.

At CHRISTUS Health, helping you enjoy your best health is more than just a goal. It’s our purpose.
It’s something each of us commits ourselves to every day. Every program, service and treatment we
provide is focused on elevating the health of all those who come to us – body, mind and spirit.

## Become One of the Faces of CHRISTUS

Join a team that extends the healing ministry of Jesus Christ and creates innovative health and
wellness solutions for individuals and communities. Join a company that values dignity, integrity
and compassion, and where you can grow and deliver quality health care.

[Hispanic woman in a suit with mid-length brunette hair smiling at the camera. ]
Associates

At CHRISTUS Health we value you, for you. We know the work you do will make a difference. Join our
family of caregivers, build your career at CHRISTUS and you’ll develop meaningful relationships
while you positively impact lives in our communities.

[ Become a CHRISTUS Associate ][117]
[Happy CHRISTUS nurse smiling into the camera with maroon scrubs on]
Nursing

Nurses are the heart of the CHRISTUS Health family. Whether you are a seasoned nurse, or a new grad,
you will find a wealth of opportunity at CHRISTUS. We care for our nurses – providing excellent
benefits, educational opportunities, shift differentials, clinical ladder programs and more -- so
our nurses can focus on care for our patients. The perfect nursing position is waiting for you.

[ Become a CHRISTUS Nurse ][118]
[Smiling Doctor with stethoscoope]
Physicians

We serve our communities by providing a complete healing experience. Above all, we are committed to
caring for the whole person – mind, body and spirit, because we understand that caring for our
patients goes beyond their physical needs. Become a CHRISTUS physician and find more than a job,
find a calling to serve patients, their families and all our communities with dignity and
compassion.

# OUR MISSION

COPE’s mission is to help people with mobility-related disabilities move on by supporting access to
physical rehabilitation services in the Lao PDR.

[Watch Video][24]

** The COPE Visitor Centre is open **

[Visit Us][25]

PEOPLE WE’VE HELPED MOVE ON

#### ["Patou" Noudaeng][26]

After my accident I had the idea of fabricating my home-made wooden leg. But it was very heavy and
not comfortable!

#### [Mr. Thongsing][27]

Because of my disability, I thought I would never marry. But luckily I found one girl in my village
who loved me as I was, and together we had two sons and built a family.

#### [Ms. Leu][28]

I love to help my father farming our fruit garden. We have so many “chan-chan” trees, it’s a
specialty from our region and it’s very tasty!

#### [Mr. Xieun][29]

I love to cultivate my garden. I am planning to plant organic vegetables, so that everyone in my
family can eat fresh and healthy vegetables.

#### [Mr. Mai][30]

I’ve always been careful about UXOs. However, one day my arm was suddenly snatched away from me.

#### [Mr. Yia Yang][31]

I have so many ducks and chickens. But my pride is my beautiful cow. She is my favorite!

#### [Mr. Siafong][32]

I never thought I would have two arms again!

#### [Vin][33]

My passion is playing football, but what I really want is to become a nurse so I can help other
people with disabilities like me.

# WHAT WE DO

Since its creation in 1996, COPE’s work has helped thousands of people with mobility-related
disabilities, including UXO survivors, access prosthetic and orthotic services, allowing them to
regain mobility and dignity.

We enable access to:
* Prosthetic devices
* Orthotic devices
* Other mobility assistive devices
* Clubfoot treatment
* Physiotherapy and occupational therapy
* Related surgical procedures

[Find Out More][34]

## Why Choose CordenPharma?

As pharma innovators, your CDMO partner must bring the expertise, scale, and regulatory strength to
support your programs at every stage. With decades of experience across six technology platforms, a
global network expansion spanning three continents, and hundreds of years of combined

drug substance to drug product. Our integrated capabilities and expanded capacity enable consistent
execution, supporting development, clinical supply, and large-scale commercial manufacturing with

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

### Facility Network

With fully-integrated cGMP facilities across Europe and North America, our small to large-scale
manufacturing capacities and technologies provide the reliable outsourcing services you need,
spanning your complete supply chain from early clinical-phase development to commercialization.

][173] [

### Project Management

Our approach to every project begins with fostering a constant exchange between the applicable API,
Drug Product and Lipid Excipient process development teams involved. Ongoing alignment with
analytical, quality and compliance support allows for faster and more consistent results, regardless
of where your project starts.

### Explore our CDMO capabilities across Technology Platforms
* [**Peptides**][175]: End‑to‑end development and manufacturing of complex peptide APIs from
  early-stage to commercial supply.
* [**Injectables**][176]**:** Clinical-to-commercial development and manufacturing of sterile
  injectable drug products, including aseptic fill and finish. 
* [**Small Molecule & Highly Potent Drug Substance**][177]:** **Scalable** **complex small molecules
  and highly potent compounds from early development through commercial supply. 
* [**Small Molecule & Highly Potent Drug Product**][178]: Flexible production of complex oral and
  sterile dosage forms, including highly potent compounds, from clinical to commercial supply.
* [**Nanomedicine**][179]:** **Integrated development and manufacturing of lipid excipients and
  nanomedicines, including LNP formulation and scalable delivery systems. 
* [**Lipids**][180]: Specialized development and large-scale manufacturing of high-quality lipid
  excipients for advanced drug delivery systems and emerging nanomedicines.

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**

* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

market-ready businesses.

## **Premium Medical Equipment Manufacturing: Why Genemax is Your Trusted Partner in Taiwan**

Looking for a reliable **medical equipment manufacturer**? Since 1992, **Genemax Medical Products
Industry Corp.** has been a global leader in the design and production of high-quality medical
devices. **Made in Taiwan**, our products leverage the country’s world-class manufacturing
technology and strict quality control standards.

* **Certified Taiwanese Manufacturing:** Our Taiwan-based facility ensures every medical device
  meets international safety and durability standards.
* **Innovative R&D & OEM/ODM Services:** We provide cutting-edge solutions and customizable
  manufacturing to meet the evolving needs of the healthcare market.
* **30+ Years of Industry Expertise:** We bridge the gap between local excellence and global demand,
  delivering tailored medical solutions for international distributors.
* **Diverse Product Portfolio:** We specialize in **manual and electric wheelchairs, home care beds,
  walkers, mobility scooters, commodes,** and **rehabilitation equipment.**

Partner with a dedicated **Taiwanese medical supplier** committed to excellence. Whether you are a
healthcare provider or a medical equipment distributor, Genemax offers the reliability your business
deserves.

# Performance Anti-Seizes, Thread Compounds, Sealants & Lubricants

## YOUR PREMIUM SOLUTION FOR MODERATE TO EXTREME CONDITIONS AND ENVIRONMENTS.

**Jet-Lube is a global-recognized brand of lubricants and compounds for oilfield, industrial and
water well markets. Its’ high-performance products withstand moderate to extreme environmental
conditions and fit many application needs within industry. Since 1949.**

Jet-Lube focuses strongly on producing high-quality anti-seizes & thread lubricants, cleaners &
degreasers, drilling compounds, extreme pressure greases, extruded gasket compounds, food grade
products, OCTG compounds, open gear lubricants, sealing compounds, thread sealants, valve injectable
packings, valve lubricants, water rehabilitation products and wire rope lubricants & oils.***
***
*Jet-Lube is a brand and registered trademark of Whitmore Manufacturing, LLC., an ISO 9001:2015 and
ISO 14001:2015 Facility.*

[Testimonial from Katherine McGuire]

our customers are overall extremely happy since standardizing on Jet-Lube. Our clients know that we
will always have this product on shelf and they know that it's going to be the same consistency no
matter what, they know that they can trust the product that's being delivered and with that trust,
they have trust in us.

Katherine McGuire
[Watch the Testimonial][82] [We Want to Hear From You!][83]

with the responsiveness. Leak repair is 24-hours / 365 days a year - they needed you five minutes
ago. When we call, they help us figure out what it is we need to get, they have a lot of different
specialty sealants to help us out with compaction rates, volumes, things like that. They get some of
this stuff done for us ahead of time - figure it out so that when we show up we're ready to rock and
roll. I can't say enough good things about the service and that really goes a long way when you're
trying to work across the country like we do. What I found with Deacon products was that they have a
variety of products that allow us to pick that temperature range and not get things so hot that it

# Performance Anti-Seizes, Thread Compounds, Sealants & Lubricants

## YOUR PREMIUM SOLUTION FOR MODERATE TO EXTREME CONDITIONS AND ENVIRONMENTS.

**Jet-Lube is a global-recognized brand of lubricants and compounds for oilfield, industrial and
water well markets. Its’ high-performance products withstand moderate to extreme environmental
conditions and fit many application needs within industry. Since 1949.**

Jet-Lube focuses strongly on producing high-quality anti-seizes & thread lubricants, cleaners &
degreasers, drilling compounds, extreme pressure greases, extruded gasket compounds, food grade
products, OCTG compounds, open gear lubricants, sealing compounds, thread sealants, valve injectable
packings, valve lubricants, water rehabilitation products and wire rope lubricants & oils.***
***
*Jet-Lube is a brand and registered trademark of Whitmore Manufacturing, LLC., an ISO 9001:2015 and
ISO 14001:2015 Facility.*

## Featured Carousel Gallery

Get Involved

## You too can make a difference.

“Parkinson's patients are the experts on what we have. We have a responsibility as patients to share
our experience — what works for us, what we respond to, what we can contribute to research.”

— Michael J. Fox

Donate
Fundraise
Participate in Research
Advocate
[Researcher holding a tablet with brain scan.]

#### Donate to Research

Your support will help usher in a future without Parkinson's disease.

[ Donate now ][109]
[Male and female couple smiling for the camera at a Tour de Fox cycling event.]

#### Fundraise for a Cure

Thousands of Team Fox members worldwide are turning their passions and interests into millions in
funding for Parkinson's research.

[ Join an event ][110]
[Person with glasses sitting down]

#### Be Part of the Answer

You have the power to impact your future and the future of millions living with Parkinson's disease.
Explore participating in clinical research today.

[ Join a study ][111]
[Two male advocates in front of the United States Capitol building at the Parkinson's Policy Forum.]

#### Public Policy Matters

Your voice and your story can shape policymakers' decisions on issues of importance to the
Parkinson's community.

[ Take action today ][112]
/
[Woman with PD]
“As more patients make the decision to participate in research studies, we’ll continue to make
faster progress toward better treatments and a cure. So, take heart. The future of Parkinson’s
research and care looks bright.”
— Anna Cohn Donnelly, D.P.H., Winnetka, Illinois

## About Us

Our Mission is to optimally enable persons with Locomotor Disabilities by quality interventions that
go beyond their medical needs and to provide him/her need based comprehensive rehabilitation through
team approach facilitating inclusion, ensuring empowerment of their families and by substantiating
field based research and development of human resources, so as to achieve their social and economic
independence, train Rehabilitation Professionals and undertake Research.

To actualize the potential of every person with locomotor disability and to ensure him/her equal
opportunities, equal rights to lead a qualitative life to protect their rights and full
participation in the society, with committed professionalism, accessible environment, positive
attitudes and appropriate, affordable, acceptable and available technological interventions.

## About Us

Our Mission is to optimally enable persons with Locomotor Disabilities by quality interventions that
go beyond their medical needs and to provide him/her need based comprehensive rehabilitation through
team approach facilitating inclusion, ensuring empowerment of their families and by substantiating
field based research and development of human resources, so as to achieve their social and economic
independence, train Rehabilitation Professionals and undertake Research.

To actualize the potential of every person with locomotor disability and to ensure him/her equal
opportunities, equal rights to lead a qualitative life to protect their rights and full
participation in the society, with committed professionalism, accessible environment, positive
attitudes and appropriate, affordable, acceptable and available technological interventions.

### Grant application guides and resources

It is always free to apply for government grants. However the process may be very complex depending
on the funding opportunity you are applying for. Let us help you!

[Apply for Grants][59]

 

> ### Inside Our Applicants Portal
> * **Grants Repository** - Access current and historic funding opportunities with ease. Thousands
>   of funding opportunities are published every week. We can help you sort through the database and
>   find the eligible ones to apply for.
> * **Applicant Video Guides** - The grant application process can be challenging to follow. We can
>   help you with intuitive video guides to speed up the process and eliminate errors in
>   submissions.
> * **Grant Proposal Wizard** - We have developed a network of private funding organizations and
>   investors across the United States. We can reach out and submit your proposal to these contacts
>   to maximize your chances of getting the funding you need.
> 
> [Access Applicants Portal][60]

 

### Premium leads for funding administrators, grant writers, and loan issuers

Thousands of people visit our website for their funding needs every day. When a user creates a grant
proposal and files for submission, we pass the information on to funding administrators, grant
writers, and government loan issuers.

If you manage government grant programs, provide grant writing services, or issue personal or
government loans, we can help you reach your audience.

### Grant application guides and resources

It is always free to apply for government grants. However the process may be very complex depending
on the funding opportunity you are applying for. Let us help you!

[Apply for Grants][59]

 

> ### Inside Our Applicants Portal
> * **Grants Repository** - Access current and historic funding opportunities with ease. Thousands
>   of funding opportunities are published every week. We can help you sort through the database and
>   find the eligible ones to apply for.
> * **Applicant Video Guides** - The grant application process can be challenging to follow. We can
>   help you with intuitive video guides to speed up the process and eliminate errors in
>   submissions.
> * **Grant Proposal Wizard** - We have developed a network of private funding organizations and
>   investors across the United States. We can reach out and submit your proposal to these contacts
>   to maximize your chances of getting the funding you need.
> 
> [Access Applicants Portal][60]

 

### Premium leads for funding administrators, grant writers, and loan issuers

Thousands of people visit our website for their funding needs every day. When a user creates a grant
proposal and files for submission, we pass the information on to funding administrators, grant
writers, and government loan issuers.

If you manage government grant programs, provide grant writing services, or issue personal or
government loans, we can help you reach your audience.

## THE RHI

# Continuum of Care

##### Research Backs All We Do

Our patients’ lives have been turned upside down by accident, stroke or other trauma, and that
drives us to always seek new and progressive treatment options. Our team of internationally
recognized doctors lead our research, finding proven results for our patients.

[More About RHI Research][193]

##### Acute Inpatient Care

Patients staying in our Eagle Highlands location receive comprehensive care delivered with a team
approach. Physicians, physical therapists, occupational therapists, speech therapists, nurses and
more guide patients to reach their maximum potential.

[Brain Injury Program][194]
[Spinal Cord Injury Program][195]
[Stroke Program][196]
[Transplant Rehabilitation][197]
[Comprehensive Acute Rehabilitation][198]
[Ancillary Services][199]

##### Outpatient Care

RHI provides a wide variety of specialized outpatient care at one convenient location, and it
doesn’t matter if a patient has been an inpatient in a different facility prior to coming for
outpatient care at RHI. From vision rehabilitation and wheelchair seating clinics to neuropsychology
services and balance retraining, RHI can prescribe the programs that will get you back to your
maximum potential. As with inpatient care, each patient works with a team of experts to reach goals.

[Outpatient Therapy][200]
[Specialized Outpatient Programs][201]
[Outpatient Locations][202]

##### Community Reintegration

Even when a patient makes tremendous progress after a traumatic incident, there still can be
challenges going back to day-to-day living. RHI’s Community Reintegration program provides resources
and support to ease that transition.

## THE RHI

# Continuum of Care

##### Research Backs All We Do

Our patients’ lives have been turned upside down by accident, stroke or other trauma, and that
drives us to always seek new and progressive treatment options. Our team of internationally
recognized doctors lead our research, finding proven results for our patients.

[More About RHI Research][193]

##### Acute Inpatient Care

Patients staying in our Eagle Highlands location receive comprehensive care delivered with a team
approach. Physicians, physical therapists, occupational therapists, speech therapists, nurses and
more guide patients to reach their maximum potential.

[Brain Injury Program][194]
[Spinal Cord Injury Program][195]
[Stroke Program][196]
[Transplant Rehabilitation][197]
[Comprehensive Acute Rehabilitation][198]
[Ancillary Services][199]

##### Outpatient Care

RHI provides a wide variety of specialized outpatient care at one convenient location, and it
doesn’t matter if a patient has been an inpatient in a different facility prior to coming for
outpatient care at RHI. From vision rehabilitation and wheelchair seating clinics to neuropsychology
services and balance retraining, RHI can prescribe the programs that will get you back to your
maximum potential. As with inpatient care, each patient works with a team of experts to reach goals.

[Outpatient Therapy][200]
[Specialized Outpatient Programs][201]
[Outpatient Locations][202]

##### Community Reintegration

Even when a patient makes tremendous progress after a traumatic incident, there still can be
challenges going back to day-to-day living. RHI’s Community Reintegration program provides resources
and support to ease that transition.

[Brain Injury Return to Work | School | Life][203]
[Brain Injury Classes][204]
[Support Groups][205]
[Wellness Program][206]
[Adaptive Sports Program][207]

#### [New Products][166]
* [[ResponderLink]][167]
  
  ### [ResponderLink][168]
  
  Shooter Detection Systems (SDS), an Alarm.com company and a global leader in gunshot detection
  solutions, has introduced ResponderLink, a groundbreaking new 911 notification service for gunshot
  events. ResponderLink completes the circle from detection to 911 notification to first responder
  awareness, giving law enforcement enhanced situational intelligence they urgently need to save
  lives. Integrating SDS’s proven gunshot detection system with Noonlight’s SendPolice platform,
  ResponderLink is the first solution to automatically deliver real-time gunshot detection data to
  911 call centers and first responders. When shots are detected, the 911 dispatching center, also
  known as the Public Safety Answering Point or PSAP, is contacted based on the gunfire location,
  enabling faster initiation of life-saving emergency protocols.
* [[AC Nio]][169]
  
  ### [AC Nio][170]
  
  Aiphone, a leading international manufacturer of intercom, access control, and emergency
  communication products, has introduced the AC Nio, its access control management software, an
  important addition to its new line of access control solutions.

  ### [Schlage Sense Pro™ Smart Deadbolt][172]
  
  Deliver true hands-free entry and reliable smart home integration with a premium deadbolt
  featuring Schlage Converge™ technology and native Matter over Thread support.

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

## Ready to turn market uncertainty into revenue clarity

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry
initiative with clear, evidence based insight.

[Connect with Our Experts][53]

Our consultants are ready to help craft a future-focused, resilient, and innovative packaging
strategy tailored to your needs.

Connect with us through [www.strategicrevenueinsights.com][54] to discover how we can support your

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

## Our Core Capabilities

### End-to-End intelligence and advisory across industries and functions.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

[Read More about Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights][50]
[Trend research illustration showing forecasting and data analysis]

## Thematic and Disruption Research

Our Thematic & Disruption Research identifies the structural shifts, emerging technologies, new
business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

Deep dives on cross-cutting themes such as sustainability, digital transformation, AI, automation,
circular economy and new revenue models. We connect these themes back to specific industry and
segment opportunities.

[Read More about Thematic and Disruption Research][51]
[Thematic and Disruption Research]

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is
resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

Support for decisions on where to play, how to win and how fast to move. This includes portfolio
focus, market entry, pricing, partnership strategy and capital allocation grounded in evidence.

[Read More about Strategic Revenue Advisory][52]
[Strategic Revenue Advisory]

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

## Ready to turn market uncertainty into revenue clarity

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry
initiative with clear, evidence based insight.

Our consultants are ready to help craft a future-focused, resilient, and innovative packaging
strategy tailored to your needs.

Connect with us through [www.strategicrevenueinsights.com][54] to discover how we can support your
packaging vision and operationalize your ambitions into tangible market impact.

### What we can offer

Technomex delivers efficient and ergonomic rehabilitation solution. For over 35 years we've been
helping our customers from rehabilitation hospitals and small rehabilitation centers to simplify
their daily responsibilities, focus on a patient and increase effectiveness of therapy.
We use technology to help you!

Concept of active treatment in virtual reality combining proven classical methods of therapy with
the possibilities of innovative technology.

][102]
[
[Robotic Assisted Gait Therapy]

#### Robotic Assisted Gait Therapy

Advanced robotic-assisted gait therapy device based on the end-effector principle.

][103]
[
[Hydrotherapy]

#### Hydrotherapy

Hydrotherapy as a branch of physiotherapy is understood as therapy in water environment. In this
category you'll find wide range of hydrotherapy devices.

][104]
[
[Kinesiotherapy]

#### Kinesiotherapy

Kinesiotherapy is defined as “treatment by movement”. It includes wide scope of therapeutical
activities. In this category you'll find rehabilitation tables and devices for active training.

][105]
[
[Cryotherapy]

#### Cryotherapy

During the treatment with physicaltherapy devices are used physical phenomena (eg. low temperature)
for therapeutic purposes.

][106]

The experience of pandemic has affected everybody worldwide. In this category you'll find protection
solution.

people with IDD.

[agency change toolkit thumb]

### [Agency Change Toolkit][54]

This toolkit contains resources and tools to facilitate organizational transformation away from
sheltered employment and non-work services and towards integrated employment and community life
supports.

## New Products

## [What People with IDD Want You to Know about HCBS Waiver Employment Services][55]

This Research to Practice brief examines the perspectives of people with IDD and their families on
Medicaid HCBS waiver employment services through focus groups and interviews. The study explores
experiences with employment supports, service delivery systems, and funding structures, identifying
key barriers and opportunities to improve access to meaningful integrated employment. Findings
highlight the importance of high-quality, person-centered services, improved coordination across
systems, stable and skilled…
[Read More][56]

## [Using Self-Directed Transportation Services to Support Competitive Integrated Employment][57]

Self-directed transportation services can help people with intellectual and developmental
disabilities (IDD) overcome one of the biggest barriers to competitive integrated employment:
getting to work.

[Read More][58]

## [Working in the Community—Update 4, The Status and Outcomes of People with Intellectual and
## Developmental Disabilities in Integrated Employment ][59]

This Special Issue Data Brief examines the employment experiences and outcomes of adults with
intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) who receive services through state IDD systems.

# Trenchless Technology for the Future of Water & Sewer Infrastructure

The world needs more resilient and sustainable infrastructure. Traditional rehabilitation and
installation methods involve intensive digging and high costs.

At Vortex, we anticipate problems, imagine solutions, and develop no-dig, trenchless technologies to
solve big infrastructure problems — cost-effectively and permanently.

[ Our Products ][65] [ Our services ][66]
A world of trenchless rehabilitation products to address any project – materials, liners, robots,
equipment and more.
The world’s first manufacturer of CIPP liners. Today, we continue that tradition with American made
cured-in-place liners delivered wet or dry across the Americas. [Visit Site][67]
The largest provider of small diameter CIPP liners and supporting equipment. Whether in-building,
laterals or patching, MaxLiner has a total solution to complete any project. [Visit Site][68]
